items.claim: When BitBucket API-token credentials are complete, collectProviderBackupResults now short-circuits past the three OAuth lookups, so a `BITBUCKET_USER_FILE`, `_KEY_FILE` or `_SECRET_FILE` naming a missing file no longer produces the `file does not exist` log line in that one combination, while provider selection is unchanged.
items.consequence: `internal/backup.go:101`, `internal/envfile.go:36`; base `internal/backup.go` evaluated all five lookups unconditionally.

items.claim: checkProvidersDefined now computes BitBucket API-token completeness before iterating the provider map, removing a map-order dependence under which the base could count both BitBucket methods, and since the count feeds only the `count == 0` check the outcome is identical.
items.consequence: `internal/backup.go:685` at head versus `bitbucketAPITokenComplete := false` at base `internal/backup.go:630`.

items.claim: The BitBucket compare-method startup log now matches `refs` with strings.EqualFold through the shared logProviderCompareMethod where the base used a ToLower equality, a difference reachable only through Unicode fold-equivalents such as U+017F.
